description: Portable maintenance smoke checks only. Extend this policy for your local features and every affected upstream path before deployment.

suites.name: whitespace-staged
command: import subprocess; p=subprocess.run(['git','rev-parse','-q','--verify','MERGE_HEAD'],stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL); args=['git','diff','--cached','--check']+(['MERGE_HEAD'] if p.returncode==0 else []); raise SystemExit(subprocess.run(args).returncode)
